name: Queen Kayri
title: The Silver Line
examine: Pale as fresh snow on the Crown terrace, and never more than a glance from the King's side. She watches a room the way a ferryman watches water, pleasantly and missing nothing.
lines: I grew up at the ford, counting toll wagons. I married up the mountain and now I count everything else.
The court gave us matching thrones and Aeriex had Stig the carpenter move them together the same week. A hand's reach, he said, or what's the point of two.
Aeriex signs the charters. I read them first. That is the whole secret of the Silver Line.
